clips.title: The story
paras: "Calling in the Reserves" is a Horde courier task entrusted to adventurers resting at Sun Rock Retreat. Maggran Earthbinder sends you south to the edge of the Barrens with orders to relieve an exhausted sentry watching the Great Lift.

Even in an era of relative prosperity following the Third War, maintaining garrisons across central Kalimdor tests the Horde's resources. At Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains, Maggran Earthbinder oversees logistics and troop welfare. Recognizing that seasoned soldiers wear thin under endless watch duty, Maggran dispatches a letter of reassignment south to the Great Lift, where a young sentry named Grish Longrunner has been standing guard far from home.

The Great Lift serves as the singular engineering artery linking the high plateaus of the southern Barrens down into the wind-carved canyons of Thousand Needles. Handing the letter over to Grish relieves him of an isolated and monotonous watch over the lift mechanisms, clearing the way for him to finally return to his family and allowing fresh reserves to step in.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Horde does well keeping our troops fresh... Since the Great War we have been prosperous here in Kalimdor.

I need you to do me a favor, I have a lad by the name of Grish Longrunner protecting the Great Lift in the southern barrens. Give him this letter; the letter will let him know that I have a reserve warrior coming to relieve him of duty so that he can visit his family. He requested this sometime ago and he would be happy to hear the news.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have news from Maggran Earthbinder?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is great news; I have been sitting here guarding this hunk of wood for too long. Now I can spend some time with my family... Yippee!
